description:
About Zyte

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data. For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy‑to‑use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

Role Overview

Zyte is seeking an experienced Team Lead to manage our Core & MLOps Squad, responsible for "Building the bedrock infrastructure that powers Zyte at scale." The position requires expertise across MLOps, systems programming, and orchestration to lead a cross‑functional team in designing and maintaining the scalable foundation that enables all Zyte teams to build and run their services with confidence.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Design and evolve the core platform (Kubernetes, Mesos, GPU scheduling/autoscaling, distributed compute).
  • Own the model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation, serving, and monitoring.
  • Build the Golden Path: reference repositories, a scaffold CLI, opinionated CI/CD pipelines, runtime contracts (health, metrics, tracing, SLOs), high‑performance clients, circuit breakers and other production‑ready defaults.

MLOps Excellence

  • Operate a secure, multi‑tenant model registry and training platform with standardized experiment/evaluation harnesses.
  • Provide turnkey serving patterns (online + batch), drift/quality monitoring, and rollback playbooks.
  • Integrate public/open‑source AI capabilities as managed platform services with cost and data‑governance guardrails.

Team Management

  • Run the squad: roadmap, prioritization, delivery, mentoring, and high engineering standards.
  • Partner with product engineering (Zyte API, Scrapy Cloud), Prod Ops, and Security on adoption and rollout plans.
  • Mentor the team and foster a platform‑thinking mindset.

Ownership Areas

At Maersk Supply Service, we believe that crewing is more than logistics—it’s about people. We’re looking for a Crew Analyst who shares our commitment to openness, collaboration, respect and to build a trustful relationship with all stakeholders, especially our offshore colleagues. If you’re someone who values transparent communication and wants to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our offshore colleagues, we’d love to hear from you.

Who are we?

At Maersk Supply Service (MSS), we’re more than a marine solutions provider—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit HR & Crewing team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What You Will Be Doing

The crewing department includes several HR subsystems, and as a Crew Analyst – Talent Attraction – you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our MSS operations.

You’ll drive alignment on talent attraction strategies and process along with the Crew Manager, will execute the talent attraction process, and build a sustainable pool of skilled professionals by leading our cadet programme—supporting the growth and development of new seafarers and helping them thrive in their maritime careers.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry, talent attraction and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, Administration or related areas.
  • MBA in Human Resource is preferable for this position.
  • 3 years of previous experience in similar roles. Previous roles in the Maritime industry would be an advantage.
  • Has a strategic mindset and understands how talent drives business success.
  • Build strong networks and knows how to attract top talent through authentic engagement.
  • Communicates with clarity and impact—whether crafting employer branding or engaging with candidates.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.
  • Champions diversity and inclusion, valuing different perspectives and backgrounds.
  • Is customer-focused, always thinking about the candidate experience.
  • Thrives on collaboration, influencing stakeholders and aligning hiring needs across teams.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong attention to detail in managing crew data, cost control, and vessel planning, ensuring smooth and compliant operations.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Focus: Proactive in identifying opportunities to enhance procedures and energise the team through continuous improvement.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 12 September 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.

You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.

You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.

  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.

  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.

  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.

  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.

  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)

  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.

  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.

  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.

  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.

  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.

  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite

  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

Zyte is seeking an experienced Team Lead to manage our Core & MLOps Squad, responsible for “Building the bedrock infrastructure that powers Zyte at scale.” This hands‑on technical leadership role requires expertise across MLOps, systems programming, and orchestration to lead a cross‑functional team in designing and maintaining the scalable foundation that enables all Zyte teams to build and run their services with confidence.

  • Design and evolve the core platform (Kubernetes, Mesos, GPU scheduling/autoscaling, distributed compute)

MLOps Excellence

  • Operate a secure, multi‑tenant model registry and training platform with standardized experiment/evaluation harnesses

  • Integrate public/open‑source AI capabilities as managed platform services with cost and data‑governance guardrails

Team Management

  • Run the squad: roadmap/prioritization, delivery, mentoring, and high engineering standards
  • Partner with product engineering (Zyte API, Scrapy Cloud), Prod Ops, and Security on adoption and rollout plans
  • Mentor the team and foster a platform‑thinking mindset

Ownership Areas

  • Container orchestration (Kubernetes/Knative), GPU provisioning & autoscaling, environment & secret management
  • Operators, sidecars, and internal SDKs/libraries (Go/Rust/Python/Java) that enforce the golden path contract
  • Model platform: registry, experiment tracking, training orchestration, evaluation framework, serving infra, model monitoring
  • Observability: logging/metrics/tracing pipelines
  • Billing pipeline: metering/events/cost tracking abstractions
  • Golden Path: Java, Python, ML templates + CI/CD blueprints + docs + scaffold CLI
  • Reliability enablement (SRE practices), cost governance, supply‑chain security (SBOM, image signing)

Qualifications

Required
  • 5+ years experience building distributed systems; 3+ years in MLOps/ML platform engineering (or equivalent impact)
  • Knowledge of Linux/OS internals (process model, cgroups/namespaces), networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/2), concurrency, and performance profiling
  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes (bonus: Mesos)
  • Proficiency developing high‑performance services in Java, Rust, Go or C++ (bonus: familiarity with vert.x and Netty frameworks); strong Python skills
  • Experience with GPU infrastructure (scheduling, containerization, optimization)
  • Track record of designing and operating model platforms (registry, training, serving, monitoring) in production
  • Demonstrated success leading technical teams and implementing organization‑wide platform solutions
Preferred
  • Streaming & workflows: Kafka plus Argo/Temporal/Airflow or equivalents
  • eBPF‑based observability, perf tooling, or io_uring experience
  • Cost optimization for ML/AI; multi‑tenant quotas and fairness
  • Hands‑on experience authoring Golden Paths (service chassis/templates, CI/CD blueprints, CLI scaffolds)
  • SRE practices (SLIs/SLOs, incident management)

Benefits

  • We love fostering and nourishing new ideas and bringing them to market
  • Become part of a self‑motivated, progressive, multi‑cultural team
  • Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work, as we are a completely remote company
  • Get the chance to work with cutting‑edge open‑source technologies and tools

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations

  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Brazil - Rio de Janeiro

O profissional será responsável pela análise crítica e pela gestão de planos de ação, além de propor soluções para problemas relacionados aos projetos da Gerência Executiva.

  • Atuação na área de gestão e processos, com foco no suporte e execução de tarefas operacionais de complexidade média. Será responsável pela análise estruturada de dados e informações, consolidada de levantamentos, além de apoiar e eventualmente orientar a realização das atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções e implementação de melhorias na gestão da rotina e dos processos da Gerência Executiva.
  • Suporte na estruturação de documentos, relatórios e apresentações; validação, análise e proposição de conteúdos; e desenvolvimento de soluções de média complexidade no atendimento das demandas na área (subeixo) em que atua. O escopo de atividades envolve pesquisas (levantamento, estruturação e consolidação de dados), análise crítica de informações consolidadas, planejamento, estruturação e execução de relatórios e apresentações, preparação de reuniões, eventos (palestras, treinamentos, workshops, reuniões gerenciais, etc.), geração de conteúdos e desenvolvimento de soluções para as demandas de trabalho, garantindo excelência, alta qualidade, desempenho e atendimento tempestivo às demandas junto às gerências que prestarão serviço.
  • Pesquisar, estruturar e consolidar informações para a composição de documentos, relatórios e pareceres relacionados à gestão das rotinas e dos processos, promovendo a consolidação, revisão e disponibilização para a avaliação e validação final dos profissionais que atuam nas demandas de complexidade alta e gestor líder da CONTRATADA, além de gestores e especialistas da PETROBRAS.
  • Será também responsável pela estruturação do material das RACs (Reuniões de Análise Crítica) e pela gestão e controle dos indicadores de desempenho e metas das gerências, com geração de alertas, levantamento do histórico e comportamento dos indicadores e metas, realização de análise crítica e estruturação da visão prospectiva e evolutiva dos resultados ao longo do ano. Deverão propor planos de ação em caso de desvios ou riscos de cumprimento de metas, cujo conteúdo e formatação deverão ser previamente avaliados e validados pelo gestor líder, antes de serem apresentados aos gestores e especialistas da PETROBRAS nos respectivos RACs de resultados gerenciais.
  • Prestar suporte direto na estruturação e desenvolvimento das propostas de indicadores de desempenho, incluindo, mas não se limitando ao levantamento de insumos, alimentação de sistemas, análises de resultados, elaboração de materiais para validação gerencial e revisões de insumos.
  • Os processos, atividades e tarefas atreladas a este quadrante de prestação de serviços são de complexidade média e exigem conhecimento específico, capacitação e experiência. title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Automação de Operações para atuar no sistema de transporte de gás natural. Esse profissional terá como missão garantir a integridade, disponibilidade e otimização dos dados operacionais, trabalhando em ambiente OT com foco em suporte ao SCADA, análise de interfaces e gestão de bases de dados históricas e em tempo real.

Além disso, será responsável por propor melhorias, desenvolver projetos em parceria com o time operacional e assegurar a conformidade com práticas de cibersegurança, bem como a integração com os sistemas de telecomunicações.

  • Inglês intermediário.

  • Conhecimento em sistemas SCADA ou semelhantes.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos industriais (Modbus, OPC, DNP3).
  • Domínio em bancos de dados (SQL, PI System, Historian).
  • Domínio em análise de dados e otimização de processos.
  • Conhecimento de Linguagem de Programação

Diferenciais

  • Domínio em ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Grafana).

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.

  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Por que trabalhar conosco

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Aqui, você será parte de uma empresa sólida, com propósito claro e que valoriza o bem-estar, o respeito.

Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que contribui para o desenvolvimento do Brasil, garantindo o transporte seguro e sustentável de gás natural.

The quality and stability of the Ubuntu Pro Client is critically important, since it comes pre-installed on every Ubuntu system. You'll work with the Ubuntu Server team, alongside major cloud partners and multiple Canonical product teams to develop, test and release improvements to the Pro client. The Pro client often interacts with the Ubuntu package management; therefore, experience in configuring apt, and knowledge of deb packaging and general system administration is advantageous in this role.
Applicants should be passionate about the Ubuntu project and its values and about building tools that are used by millions of people around the world. A personal interest and emphasis on quality, thinking of edge cases, ease of use, documentation, and careful community coordination is important. The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nosso objetivo é enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, melhorando sua vida através do que entregamos.

O time de Banking:

A estrutura de Product Platforms | Banking tem o propósito de prover serviços bancários para todos os segmentos da StoneCo, auxiliando no engajamento da base de clientes, no aumento do LTV e na redução de churn, tornando-se uma das principais fontes de receita da companhia através dos times de Core Transacional, Cartões, Baas, BPNA, Banking Processes e Open Finance.

Nosso objetivo é desenvolver soluções que garantam que, após a venda, o empreendedor possa receber e usar seu dinheiro, pagando seus funcionários, fornecedores e tributos, além de administrar seus recursos para prosperar.

Atuamos em todo o ciclo de vida do cliente, conectando suas vendas à gestão de sua empresa, apresentando e ampliando nossa gama de serviços, garantindo que sejamos seu provedor financeiro único.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Location

Brazil

Department

Broadcast & Media Operations

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play‑off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027). The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections, and the escalation of risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the ongoing development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On‑going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast‑related overlay, as well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on‑site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro FIFA office. Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre‑planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play‑off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast‑paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high‑pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high‑quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Join to apply for the Financial Analyst role at Canonical

Overview

As a Financial Analyst, you'll be a core member of the FP&A Team and wider finance team. You will play a key part in our monthly business reviews, quarterly forecasting, annual planning, financial modeling, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a desire to learn how to leverage business judgment, driven by data, to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.

Location

This is a remote role in EMEA or Americas time zones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate insights into business operations by analyzing unit economics, drivers of variance, and other KPIs

  • Create objective analyses and processes for a fast-growing tech company to scale efficiently and make data-driven decisions
  • Support multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy
  • Partner with and communicate business progress to key stakeholders against financial and strategic targets

Valued skills and experience

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, or related field

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Reservatórios Especialista
description:

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multifuncional e cada desafio é único! Estamos buscando um Engenheiro(a) de Reservatórios Especialista para compor nosso time de subsuperfície com sólida experiência na gestão integrada de campos maduros offshore, atuando ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida do reservatório — desde caracterização geológica e modelagem dinâmica até planejamento de desenvolvimento, otimização da produção e suporte técnico a decisões de alto impacto.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conhece e aplica com autoridade métodos analíticos de previsão de comportamento de produção (DCA, Balanço de Materiais e RTA).
  • Experiência na condução de estudos de revitalização, waterflooding, propostas de novos poços, integração com equipes multidisciplinares, além de experiência com auditorias de reservas (PRMS).
  • Experiência na condução de processos e entregáveis regulatórios junto à ANP, incluindo elaboração, revisão e alinhamento de BAR (Boletim Anual de Reservas), PAT (Plano Anual de Trabalho), PD (Plano de Desenvolvimento) e demais demandas técnicas.
  • Liderar e participar de avaliações de novos ativos construindo cenários probabilísticos para uma melhor avaliação econômica.
  • Experiência com estimativa, avaliação e classificação de recursos e reservas.
  • Responsável pela mentoria e desenvolvimento de talentos na área de reservatórios, bem como colaborar na construção de propostas de melhoria no plano de carreira do engenheiro.
  • Participar no planejamento e desenho de bids técnicos de contratos de aquisição de dados, ensaios e projetos de tecnologia em engenharia de reservatórios.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica (graduação ou curso técnico); Graduação em Engenharia (Petróleo, Produção, Química, Civil e Mecânica).
  • Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória; domínio avançado de simulação numérica (Eclipse/INTERSECT/CMG), análises PVT e SCAL, interpretação de testes de formação e testes de produção, além de forte atuação em incertezas, previsões, certificação de reservas e processos corporativos de tomada de decisão.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Esse papo também abordará a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e esclarecer dúvidas. Dicas: queremos saber sobre experiências alinhadas aos valores da PRIO, apresentando contextos, responsabilidades, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado. Em seguida, aspectos mais técnicos podem envolver um case ou entrevista com o gestor da vaga para conhecer os desafios técnicos e serem avaliados dentro dos requisitos. Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da área para a escolha final.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Atualize-se sobre notícias recentes da empresa, seja pela imprensa ou pelo site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO;
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre insucessos. Desejamos um bom processo seletivo. Venha fazer parte da PRIO.

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único. Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Senior Designer
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.

You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.

You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.

  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.

  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.

  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.

  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.

  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)

  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.

  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.

  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.

  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.

  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.

  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite

  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Overview

Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho deve garantir a integridade física e a saúde dos colaboradores próprios e terceiros, a conformidade legal e a prevenção de acidentes nas operações de transportes e logística da DeLuna, promovendo uma cultura de segurança alinhada aos valores e metas ESG da empresa.

Requisitos

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho concluído. Registro/credenciamento profissional.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em operações de logística, armazenagem e transportes.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
  • NRs aplicáveis (NR-01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 10, 11, 12, 17, 20, 23, 26, 33, 35).
  • PGR, inventário de riscos, APR, permissões de trabalho, investigação de acidentes.
  • Segurança em armazéns, docas, empilhadeiras, amarração e movimentação de cargas.
  • Noções de saúde ocupacional e eSocial.
  • Combate a incêndio e brigada; plano de emergência e simulados.
  • Ergonomia aplicada a logística e operações frigorificadas.
  • Ferramentas:
  • Pacote Office/Google e ferramentas de checklists/auditorias digitais.
  • Sistemas de gestão de SST/SESMT e eSocial.
  • Habilitações/cursos desejáveis:
  • Instrutor NR-35/NR-33, brigada de incêndio, direção defensiva.
  • Noções de ISO 45001 e ISO 14001; primeiros socorros.
  • CNH B; disponibilidade para viagens.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Foco em segurança e cuidado ativo; presença em campo.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos diversos.
  • Influência e negociação para gerenciamento de mudanças.
  • Organização, senso de urgência e disciplina na gestão de planos de ação.
  • Colaboração e postura consultiva com atendimento personalizado, alinhada aos valores DeLuna.
  • Integridade, confidencialidade e respeito às pessoas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em operações e-commerce/last mile.
  • Experiência com gestão de transportadores terceiros e auditorias de clientes.
  • Participação em projetos de certificação e programas de cultura de segurança.

Responsabilidades e Atividades

  • Governança SST e Compliance
  • Atuar como integrante do SESMT conforme dimensionamento da NR-04.
  • Implementar e manter o PGR com inventário de riscos e plano de ação; apoiar as avaliações de exposição conforme NRs vigentes.
  • Apoiar a CIPA no dimensionamento, capacitação e cronograma anual; organizar SIPAT.
  • Gerir EPI/EPC: especificação, distribuição, rastreabilidade, controle de vida útil e treinamentos.
  • Assegurar conformidade com NRs aplicáveis às operações DeLuna.
  • Acompanhar legislação aplicável ao transporte e logística e requisitos de clientes.
  • Operações de CDs, XPTs e Transit Points
  • Realizar inspeções de rotina e emitir relatórios com planos de ação.
  • Validar layout seguro, sinalização, rotas de pedestres/empilhadeiras, proteção de estruturas, housekeeping.
  • Conduzir análises ergonômicas pontuais e propor melhorias.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de combate a incêndio e suportar brigada de incêndio;
  • Verificar condições de câmaras frias e EPIs térmicos em operações frigorificadas.
  • Transporte Rodoviário (FM/MM/LM, LH)
  • Apoiar programas de direção defensiva, análise de rotas críticas, gestão de fadiga e pausas.
  • Realizar inspeções de frota focadas em segurança.
  • Verificar documentação e treinamentos obrigatórios de motoristas e ajudantes conforme a legislação aplicável.
  • Conduzir DDS e blitz de segurança em pátios e pontos de apoio.
  • Investigar sinistros rodoviários e quase-acidentes, propondo ações corretivas e lições aprendidas.
  • Saúde Ocupacional e eSocial
  • Interface com PCMSO e Médico do Trabalho: exames admissionais, periódicos, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função.
  • Apoiar os eventos do eSocial em conjunto com RH/DP e colaboradores.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de laudos e avaliações por profissionais legalmente habilitados, providenciando dados e acompanhando planos de ação.
  • Treinamentos, Cultura e Comunicação
  • Planejar, ministrar e/ou coordenar treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos.
  • Gerenciar a matriz de capacitação, controles de validade e reciclagens; garantir 100% de aderência.
  • Conduzir campanhas e comunicações de segurança, reforçando os valores e a cultura DeLuna.
  • Emergências e Preparação/Resposta
  • Manter plano de emergência atualizado: cenários em armazéns, câmaras frias, incêndio, vazamento de combustíveis, sinistros rodoviários.
  • Realizar simulados periódicos com brigada e times operacionais; alinhar com corpo de bombeiros e contratadas.
  • Garantir kits de emergência, fichas de segurança e contatos úteis disponíveis e atualizados.
  • Gestão de Terceiros e Fornecedores
  • Qualificar, auditar e acompanhar prestadores sob critérios de SST; verificar documentos, treinamentos e indicadores.
  • Incluir requisitos de SST em contratos e SLAs em parceria com Suprimentos e Jurídico.
  • Acompanhar execução de manutenção predial e de equipamentos por terceiros com Permissão de Trabalho quando aplicável.
  • ESG e Melhoria Contínua
  • Contribuir para metas ESG.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas/externas e requisitos de clientes;
  • Liderar investigação de incidentes com metodologia estruturada e garantir a eficácia das ações.

Acreditamos que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas oportunidades estão abertas para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, raça, idade, identidade, orientação ou condição.

Descrição do Cargo

Nosso projeto de implantação do SAP S/4HANA está redefinindo toda a estrutura Contábil-Gerencial da organização. Procuramos um(a) Consultor(a) SAP CO Sênior para ser referência funcional no desenho e governança dos processos de Costing & Controlling, garantindo aderência ao Universal Journal, integridade FI/CO e padronização Clean Core.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar com blueprint e desenho dos processos CO (TO-BE) com base nas SAP Best Practices e Clean Core.
  • Estruturar modelos de custos, planejamento, rateios, fechamentos e rentabilidade conforme arquitetura S/4 (ACDOCA, ACDOCP).
  • Mapear processos no SAP Signavio, garantindo governança, versionamento e rastreabilidade.
  • Avaliar impactos sistêmicos e integrações via LeanIX, conectando CO com FI, MM, PP, SD, PM, EWM e TRM.
  • Criar especificações funcionais enxutas para extensões via SAP BTP (workflows, regras, validações).
  • Planejar e executar testes integrados e cenários de performance financeira via SAP CLAM/ALM.
  • Suportar Controladoria e Operações durante UAT, cutover, reconciliações e estabilização.
  • Garantir governança do Universal Journal, minimizando customizações e evitando divergências FI/CO.
  • Atuar como advisor de negócio para decisões baseadas em rentabilidade e custo.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em SAP CO.
  • Histórico comprovado em projetos SAP S/4HANA (Greenfield ou Brownfield).
  • Domínio do Universal Journal (ACDOCA), modelos de valuation, paralelismo e integração FI/CO.
  • Forte entendimento de Clean Core, Activate, Best Practices, Signavio, LeanIX e CLAM.
  • Capacidade consultiva e habilidade de dialogar com controladoria, contabilidade, planejamento e operações.
  • Visão arquitetural de integrações cross-module.

Expertise por Subprocesso CO

  • CO-PC – Product Costing: Cálculo de custos de produto, BOMs, roteiros, costing sheets, WIP, variâncias, integração com PP/QM/WM/EWM.
  • CO-CCA – Cost Center Accounting: Estrutura de centros de custo, rateios, ciclos, drivers, hierarquias, planejamento e análise orçamentária.
  • CO-OPA – Internal Orders: Configuração e controle de ordens internas, integração com ativos (AA) e derivação de contas.
  • CO-PA – Profitability Analysis: Margin Analysis no Universal Journal, cenários de rentabilidade, integração com SD/MM.
  • CO-ML – Material Ledger: Configuração e operação de ML para valuation real-time, diferenças de preço, múltiplos valuations.

Soft Skills e Mindset

  • Raciocínio financeiro forte com visão ponta a ponta.
  • Postura consultiva e capacidade de “challenge” ao negócio dentro da governança Clean Core.
  • Comunicação clara com executivos, controladoria, supply chain e TI.
  • Mentalidade de arquitetura corporativa, não apenas funcional.

  • Wellhub: Benefícios e descontos em academias e programas de bem-estar.

  • Neoris Global Campus: Plataforma de desenvolvimento com oportunidades contínuas de aprendizado e crescimento profissional.

We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross‑functional projects.

Requisitos para Soldado

Os requisitos para o concurso de Soldado do Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Estado do Rio de Janeiro são criteriosamente estabelecidos para garantir a qualidade dos candidatos. Os interessados devem atender a uma série de condições que envolvem tanto aspectos físicos quanto educacionais.

  • Escolaridade: É necessário ter o ensino médio completo.

  • Documentação: Os candidatos precisam apresentar certidões e documentos pessoais, incluindo comprovante de residencia.

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Rio de Janeiro, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. About Us

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy.
